note: Lakeside park on spring-fed Deep Lake near Oxford, about 20 minutes from Wisconsin Dells; managed by Heartland Parks. Mostly seasonal: the campground map marks only sites 43-46 as overnight sites, among about 62 RV sites and some 30 year-round mobile-home lots. The overnight sites are inland; the sites near the lake path are seasonal. Private beach, fishing dock, paddle boats. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, about, policies, FAQs, mobile-home lots, amenities), 2026 campground map, ResNexus (two 2027 Tuesdays), Google panel and imagery read. DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay): operator 'specialize[s] in seasonal RV sites', map marks 4 of ~62 RV sites as overnight (<1 in 10), policy limits nightly use of seasonal sites to 'family members of registered guests only', mobile-home lots rented year-round and offered 'for sale'; both daily 50-amp sites unavailable on both test nights. Fees $45 left (no daily RV price shown on the engine). Booking ResNexus, season May 1 - Oct 31, electric 50, laundry/WiFi added. Lakeview stored applies only to seasonal sites: nightly sites not waterfront. Phone differs.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - long-stay / mostly seasonal. (1) Operator leads with seasonal: 'Settle In for the Season at Deep Lake'; 'We specialize in seasonal RV sites, with additional short-term RV spots'; 'with a strong focus on seasonal RV living'. (2) Nightly share: the 2026 campground map's legend 'Overnight Sites' shades only sites 43, 44, 45 and 46, of RV sites numbered 1-62 (about 6%: fails test 4, under 1 in 10); ResNexus labels 13 of the 17 RV sites it lists 'designated for long term seasonal camping' (or 'short term seasonal' for 44 and 45) and offers only 15 and 16 (50 amp) as ordinary sites, both UNAVAILABLE on Tue 2027-06-15 and Tue 2027-09-14. (3) Wording that discourages nightly guests: 'Unused seasonal sites may be available for nightly rentals for family members of registered guests only' and 'Tent Sites: For family members of registered guests only' (resort policies). (4) Test 5: mobile-home lots rented for year-round residency at $540/month, and the amenities page says 'Ask us about our available mobile home lots for sale'. Google 4.5 (94). Read as mostly seasonal; price itself passes ('Nightly rates starting at $45/night', Wisconsin Dells gateway 20 km).

WATERFRONT: stored lakeview. Imagery (leaf-off) shows the curved row of sites by the lake path (map sites 19-31, around 43.7797,-89.6487) about 50-60 m from Deep Lake through wooded slope, but those are seasonal sites; the overnight sites 43-46 sit inland in the middle of the park, and the daily 15/16 are in the 1-16 block by the office. FAQ claims 'prime lakefront spots' (a contrary claim, lead). Seasonal-only sites don't earn the value: nightly sites -> not waterfront. Suggested waterfront_evidence: '2026 campground map + Esri 2026-11-16: overnight sites 43-46 inland; lake-path row 19-31 ~50-60 m from Deep Lake through trees but seasonal -> not waterfront'.

PHONE: stored 608-535-8531 (Google's number and ResNexus's seasonal line) -> 608-602-2095 (website header/footer on every page). The 2026 map and ResNexus office line give 608-586-5644. Suggest 608-602-2095.
